sloka: तथा इति उवाच एनम् रावणम् ताटका सुतः ।ततो रावण मारीचौ विमानम् इव तम् रथम् ॥३-४२-९॥
transliteration: tathā iti uvāca enam rāvaṇam tāṭakā sutaḥ ।tato rāvaṇa mārīcau vimānam iva tam ratham ॥3-42-9॥

translations.english: Thereafter Ravana and Maricha ascended the chariot, which was like an aerial car, and quickly departed from that cluster of hermitages.
